type.source_name: Labelplanet LP27/63; Avery Zweckform catalogue 2022 (size only)
type.notes: Vendor template pages not reachable (HTTP 403). Size 63.5 x 29.6 mm and 27 per sheet confirmed by the Avery Zweckform catalogue 2022 (https://www.avery-zweckform.com/sites/default/files/2022-01/X93000-2022_Hauptkatalog_deutsch.pdf); grid, pitch and margins from Labelplanet LP27/63 only (same size and count, listed there without the L4737 code). Corner radius not stated anywhere; measure. No vertical gap (pitch 29.6 = label height). Labelplanet notes the height is sometimes manufactured slightly below 29.6 mm. Material: removable. Left margin measured 6.95 mm on two check prints (Labelplanet: 7.25); the die cut sits off-centre.
